notes: assemblies merge collision geometry within one rigid link, bridge the complete plate spacing, and preserve the exterior profile. A 25 micrometre profile cleanup plus outward margin avoids tiny tessellation notches; the result is clipped to the full 3D convex envelope. Visual CAD meshes and mass properties remain unchanged. outline_parts preserve individual rail/finger outlines while filling holes/grooves. Values in parts are CoACD caps for other brackets. Other parts default to one convex hull.

upper_arm_shell.purpose: One continuous collision envelope for J2-J3: two plates, supports and the enclosed motor. Fill the cavity across the plates while retaining the outer XZ profile.

forearm_shell.purpose: One continuous collision envelope for J3-J4: all four plates, all six cylindrical spacers, supports and the enclosed motor. Fill both plate-pair cavities and the connecting region.
